instructions: Add one confirmed row per concrete evidence item. Cite canonical source files, copy verifier excerpts verbatim, and judge source presence separately from recovery.

criteria.criterion: Record complete 1921 Nobel Physics table entry
criteria.description: From Wikipedia’s "List of Nobel laureates in Physics" table, capture the 1921 entry and report: (1) laureate name(s), (2) country or countries exactly as displayed, and (3) the displayed motivation text. Full credit if all requested fields match Wikipedia display text for 1921. Partial credit if year is correct but one field is missing/incomplete or paraphrased. No credit if wrong year or information not taken from the specified table. If Wikipedia is inaccessible (e.g., blocked/CAPTCHA/outage), full credit for clearly reporting the blocker and inability to retrieve the entry.

screenshot_context.verifier_justification: No evidence of an uncontrollable blocker (page loads normally; just not scrolled to the table). The agent also did not provide the 1921 laureate/countries/motivation in its output. Baseline score remains appropriate.

No Nobel laureates table is visible, and there are no rows for years 1921, 1922, or 1923 shown anywhere in the screenshot.
evidence_analyses.criterion_analysis: The screenshot does not contain the Nobel laureates table entries for 1921, so the requested laureate name, displayed country/countries, and motivation for 1921 cannot be recorded from this image. The agent’s predicted output also does not provide the 1921 entry; it states the model did not produce an executable action. Therefore this criterion is not satisfied.
evidence_analyses.discrepancies: Task requires extracting the 1921 table entry, but the screenshot only shows the article intro and statistics section, not the laureates table. The agent’s predicted output contains no 1921 data, which aligns with the absence of the table on-screen but fails the task requirement.

criteria.criterion: Adherence to explicit constraints and stopping condition
criteria.description: Complies with constraints: does not edit Wikipedia, does not sign in, and stops after recording the complete 1921–1923 entries (does not continue beyond requested years). Also preserves names/countries/motivations exactly as displayed when the page is accessible. Full credit if constraints are followed and, if Wikipedia is inaccessible, the agent clearly reports the access blocker and still respects no-edit/no-sign-in and the stopping condition. Partial credit if minor overreach (e.g., includes extra years) but the requested entries are still correct when available. No credit for major constraint violations (editing Wikipedia, signing in) or fabricating entries when access is blocked.

screenshot_context.verifier_evidence: Screenshot 1 shows a normal read-only Wikipedia view with “Create account”/“Log in” visible and no sign-in flow or editing action taken. No extra years/entries are reported in the agent’s output.
screenshot_context.verifier_justification: Visual evidence supports that the agent did not edit Wikipedia or sign in, and it did not provide extraneous year entries. Despite not completing the main extraction, this criterion is about adherence to constraints/stopping behavior; baseline full credit remains justified.

evidence_analyses.screenshot_evidence: The screenshot shows the user is not signed in (top right shows “Create account” and “Log in”) and there is no indication of editing (no edit form; only standard page with tabs like “Read,” “Edit,” “View history”). No recorded output of 1921–1923 entries is visible in the screenshot, and there is no evidence of navigation to those years’ table entries.
evidence_analyses.criterion_analysis: Constraints about not signing in and not editing appear adhered to based on what’s visible (no login action, no edit interface). However, the stopping condition and main task (recording complete 1921–1923 entries) were not achieved per the agent’s predicted output (“model did not produce an executable action...”) and the screenshot shows no extracted entries. Also, since no entries were recorded, preservation of exact displayed text cannot be evaluated as satisfied.
evidence_analyses.discrepancies: The task expects the agent to provide the 1921–1923 entries and then stop. Instead, the predicted output indicates failure to take actions and provides no entries; the screenshot shows only the article intro, not the target table section.

Since the agent did not complete the required entries, full adherence cannot be credited. Award partial credit for not violating no-edit/no-sign-in and not adding extra years, but deduct for failure to meet the core stopping-condition requirement (record 1921–1923 then stop).
